dimensions.assessment: Directly impacts the government and residents of the District of Columbia through revised federal oversight.
Modifies review timelines, expands congressional disapproval powers to individual provisions, executive orders, and regulations.
No federal spending or revenue implications are stated.
Amends the District of Columbia Home Rule Act regarding review periods, expedited procedures, and regulatory oversight.
Permanent statutory change to the review and oversight process for future District of Columbia laws and regulations.

importance_detail.rationale: The bill alters the congressional review process for District of Columbia laws, executive orders, and regulations by establishing a uniform 60-day review period and expanding disapproval mechanisms.
